name: Ch.4 · A Song of Peace
gameInstructions: Choose the three words that best tell Deborah's story.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: When the danger had passed, Deborah and Barak sang.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They remembered every willing heart, every brave step, and the God who had gone before them.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The land rested for forty years.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Deborah's story reminds us: listen closely, stand together, and use courage to make peace.
